# Every 0x101 frame from 18:06:58.9 to 18:07:00.6 local (CEST), the transition this bike
# makes every time it leaves 60/62 for drive. The substate walks 46 -> 150 -> 41 -> 42 ->
# 47 -> 143 -> 47 -> 51 -> 59 -> 43 and does so identically 9 times out of 9 across the
# three boots of 2026-09-13; this is one of them, committed so docs/can-0x101.md's headline
# claim is reproducible without the 70 MB extract it came from.
#
# byte 0 = V_VEHICLE_SUBSTATE, byte 1 = V_VEHICLE_STATE, byte 2 = V_DRIVE_VSM.
# Byte 2 is 4 for the WHOLE of this chain, and was already 4 while parked: it reads 6 only in
# the three driving substates (43, 52, 53), so it changes once, three frames after 43 arrives.
# 150 and 143 are the two bit-7 substates, which belong to no state band -- byte 1 holds its
# value through them.
